instruction: Impute missing values in time-series data using multiple strategies and evaluate their accuracy. Implement linear and spline interpolation for gap-filling, apply forward-fill and backward-fill as baseline methods, and use KNN imputation to leverage relationships between neighboring time steps or correlated channels. Handle gaps of varying lengths differently — short gaps may use interpolation while long gaps may require model-based approaches. Quantify imputation quality using RMSE and MAE against held-out ground truth values, and visualize original, masked, and imputed signals for comparison.
description: Impute missing values in time-series data using interpolation, KNN, and fill-based strategies. Evaluate imputation quality against ground truth using RMSE and MAE.
keywords: missing data, imputation, interpolation, KNN imputation, forward-fill, backward-fill, time-series, python, pandas, scikit-learn, gap filling, RMSE
